device.label: a BC547B
device.note: The datasheet's hFE classification B is 200 to 450 at I_C = 2 mA and V_CE = 5 V; the lower limit of that group is used here, so a real specimen can only do better.

source.title: ON Semiconductor BC546/BC547/BC548 datasheet, hFE classification (group B: 200-450 at I_C = 2 mA, V_CE = 5 V)

device.label: a BC547C
device.note: The same part sorted into its high-gain group: hFE 420 to 800. One transistor type can differ by a factor of four from bin to bin, which is why beta is measured and not looked up.

source.title: ON Semiconductor BC546/BC547/BC548 datasheet, hFE classification (group C: 420-800 at I_C = 2 mA, V_CE = 5 V)

device.label: a P2N2222A
device.note: The datasheet guarantees hFE of at least 100 at I_C = 10 mA and V_CE = 10 V; that minimum is used here.

source.title: ON Semiconductor P2N2222A datasheet, DC current gain hFE minimum 100 at I_C = 10 mA, V_CE = 10 V

supply.label: V_CC = 6 V
supply.note: A lower collector supply brings the working point closer to the knee, and the measured gain changes a little with it (the Early effect).
